title: NeuroMamba: A State-Space Foundation Model for Functional MRI
venue: NeurIPS 2025 Workshop on Foundation Models for the Brain and Body (Spotlight)
abstract: Functional MRI yields high-dimensional 4D spatiotemporal brain recordings that are computationally intractable for quadratic self-attention transformers at scale. We present NeuroMamba, the first selective state-space foundation model architecture for 4D fMRI sequences, enabling linear computational scaling with respect to scan duration and superior transferability across diverse cognitive decoding benchmarks.
